newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Payment wins CompUSA contract.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Payment wins CompUSA contract.

text.p: Midwest Payment Systems said Monday it has won a three-year contract to process credit card payments for CompUSA Inc.
Midwest now processes Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, Diners Club and JCB International payments for CompUSA.
In December, Midwest converted CompUSA's credit authorization and Visa/MasterCard settlement systems to Midwest's systems in a single weekend.
Midwest is a a subsidiary of Fifth Third Bancorp which processes ATM and POS transactions for financial institutions and merchants worldwide.
